sentences.en: Hello, and thank you for asking me to your teachers' meeting to talk about the Dinosaur Museum and to tell you a bit about what you can do with your students there.
sentences.zh: 你好，感谢你们邀请我参加教师会议，向大家介绍恐龙博物馆，并简要说明你们可以带学生在那里开展哪些活动。

sentences.en: Well, let me give you some of the basic information first.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我先提供一些基本信息。

sentences.en: In regard to opening hours, we're open every day of the week from 9.00 am to 8.00 pm except on Mondays when we close at 1.30 pm.
sentences.zh: 关于开放时间，我们每周每天都开放，时间为上午9点至晚上8点，但每周一例外，仅开放至下午1点30分。

sentences.en: And, in fact the only day in the year when we're closed is on the 25th of & 12 December.
sentences.zh: 事实上，全年唯一闭馆的日子是12月25日。

sentences.en: You can book a guided tour for your school group any time that we're open.
sentences.zh: 你们可以在我们开放的任何时段为学校团体预约导览服务。

sentences.en: If you bring a school group to the museum, when you arrive we ask you to remain with your group in the car park.
sentences.zh: 如果你们带学校团体来博物馆，抵达后请在停车场内与学生一起等候。

sentences.en: One or more of the tour guides will welcome you there and brief you about what the tour will be about.
sentences.zh: 一名或多名导览员将在那里迎接你们，并向你们简要介绍导览内容。

sentences.en: We do this there because our entrance is quite small and we really haven't got much room for briefing groups in the exhibition area.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以选择在停车场进行简报，是因为博物馆入口较小，展览区内实在没有足够空间供团体集中听取说明。

sentences.en: As far as the amount of time you'll need goes, if you bring a school group a you should plan on allowing a minimum of 90 minutes for the visit.
sentences.zh: 至于所需时间，如果你们带学校团体前来参观，建议至少预留90分钟。

sentences.en: This allows 15 minutes to get on and off the coach, 45 minutes for the guided tour and 30 minutes for after-tour activities.
sentences.zh: 这包括15分钟上下大巴、45分钟导览以及30分钟导览后的活动时间。

sentences.en: If you're going to have lunch at the museum you will, of course, have to allow more time.
sentences.zh: 如果你们计划在博物馆内用餐，当然还需额外预留更多时间。

sentences.en: There are two cafés in the museum, with seating for 80 people.
sentences.zh: 博物馆内设有两家咖啡馆，共可容纳80人就座。

sentences.en: If you want to eat there you'll need to reserve some seating, as they can get quite crowded at lunch time.
sentences.zh: 如需在咖啡馆用餐，须提前预订座位，因为午餐时段通常非常拥挤。

sentences.en: Then outside the museum at the back there are tables, and students can bring their own lunch and eat it there in the open air.
sentences.zh: 此外，博物馆后方户外区域设有餐桌，学生可自带午餐，在户外用餐。

sentences.en: When the students come into the museum foyer we ask them to check in their backpacks with their books, lunch boxes, etc, at the cloakroom before they enter the museum proper.
sentences.zh: 当学生进入博物馆门厅时，我们要求他们将背包、课本、午餐盒等物品寄存在衣帽间，之后再进入正式展区。

sentences.en: I'm afraid in the a past we have had a few things gone missing after school visits so this is a strict rule.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，过去曾发生过几次学校团体参观后物品遗失的情况，因此这是一项严格规定。

sentences.en: Also, some of the exhibits are fragile and we don't want them to be accidentally knocked.
sentences.zh: 另外，部分展品较为脆弱，我们不希望它们被意外碰倒。

sentences.en: But we do provide school students with handouts with questions and quizzes on -18 them.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们会向学生发放讲义，其中包含相关问题和小测验。

sentences.en: There's so much that students can learn in the museum and it's fun for them to have something to do.
sentences.zh: 博物馆内可供学生学习的内容非常丰富，而这些活动也能让他们乐在其中。

sentences.en: Of course they'll need to bring something to write with for these.
sentences.zh: 当然，学生需自备书写工具以完成这些任务。

sentences.en: We do -18 allow students to take photographs.
sentences.zh: 我们允许学生拍照。

sentences.en: For students who are doing projects it's useful to make some kind of visual record of what they see that they can add to their reports.
sentences.zh: 对于正在开展课题研究的学生而言，拍摄一些视觉资料有助于他们日后撰写报告。

sentences.en: And finally, they should not bring anything to eat into the museum, or drinks of any kind.
sentences.zh: 最后，请注意：学生不得携带任何食物或饮料进入博物馆。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts +.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 听力原文+

sentences.en: LA There are also a few a things the students can do after the tour.
sentences.zh: 此外，学生导览结束后还可参与一些其他活动。

sentences.en: In the theatrette on the S a or a 20 m ground floor there are continuous screenings of short documentaries about dinosaurs which they can see at any time.
sentences.zh: 位于一楼（即地面层）的小型影院会循环播放有关恐龙的短纪录片，学生可在任意时间观看。

sentences.en: We used to have an activity room with more interactive things like making models of dinosaurs and drawing and painting pictures, even hunting for dinosaur eggs, but unfortunately the room was damaged in a bad storm recently when water came in the roof, so that's closed at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我们原先设有一间活动室，提供更富互动性的活动，例如制作恐龙模型、绘画、涂色，甚至模拟寻找恐龙蛋；但不幸的是，最近一场强风暴导致屋顶漏水，该房间受损，目前暂时关闭。

sentences.en: But we do have an IT centre where students have access to CD ROMs with a range of dinosaur games.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们设有信息技术中心，学生可使用配备多种恐龙主题游戏的CD-ROM。

sentences.en: These games are a lot a & 20 of fun, but they also teach the students about the lives of dinosaurs, how they found food, protected their habitat, survived threats, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 这些游戏趣味十足，同时还能帮助学生了解恐龙的生活习性，例如它们如何觅食、保护栖息地、应对威胁等。

sentences.en: And . . .
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: I think that's all have to tell you.
sentences.zh: 我想我要介绍的内容就这些了。

sentences.en: Please feel free to ask any questions if you would like to know anything else . ..
sentences.zh: 如果各位还有其他问题，欢迎随时提问。
